notes.title: Wholesome Direct Participation & Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hello!
We have some exciting updates to share with you.


We're joining Wholesome Direct 2025


We are thrilled to announce that A Tiny Wander will be participating in Wholesome Direct 2025, the global showcase for cozy indie games!



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45335249/5e336d84ef8830798ea94cbd8e841b053ca72db0.jpg"]


This event has always been a dream of ours, and we can’t believe we get to be a part of it. Additionally, this year marks the 5th anniversary of Wholesome Direct, making it an extra-special celebration. It’s bound to be more exciting than ever! 

Don’t miss this chance to check it out!



Wholesome Direct 2025

⏰June 8th at 1 AM (JST)
　 June 7th at 9 AM (PT) / 12 PM (ET) / 6 PM (CET)

　
📺 YOUTUBE:[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/D4ZRXGcmDlM?si=YmhdnOGs81FXprjS"][/dynamiclink]

🎮 Twitch: wholesome_games


[hr][/hr]

Release Date Postponement


We originally aimed to release A Tiny Wander in 2025, but we have decided to postpone the launch to 2026.



The reason for this change is our commitment to delivering a more enjoyable experience for everyone. We are focusing on enhancing both the volume and quality of the game, which has caused delays in development. As a result, we have made the difficult decision to reschedule the release.


We sincerely apologize to those who were looking forward to the 2025 launch. Our team is working hard to bring you the best possible game, and we truly appreciate your continued support.
Thank you for your patience, and we hope you’ll look forward to A Tiny Wander!



[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45335249/93a56de2931721b1c84e7032c03b9035d0e4f66b.jpg"]
